text: Aotearoa New Zealand’s first National Adaptation Plan (NAP) is a comprehensive strategy to address the irreversible impacts of climate change. Launched in August 2022, it consolidates current and future government actions into a six-year program aimed at minimizing climate-related damage and building resilience across sectors and communities. The plan emphasizes protection of homes and buildings, urban planning to reduce risk exposure, and strengthening Māori connections to land and cultural knowledge. It is monitored by the Climate Change Commission for effectiveness.
